|errata_history={{Card errata/Tarkin Doctrine}}
This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Tarkin Doctrine (Set 0, Original)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Tarkin Doctrine (Set 0, Original)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-tdoc-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 6. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 6 August 2016.</ref>. Dated by 6 August 2016 (the earliest preserved copy of the Set 0 slip sheet); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Tarkin Doctrine (Set 0, Original) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “Deploy on Death Star. During your control phase, for each battleground system controlled by your Star Destroyer within 2 parsecs of Death Star, opponent loses 1 Force. Canceled if opponent controls this system.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tarkin Doctrine]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-tdoc-1">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 4 July 2017.</ref>. Dated by 4 July 2017 (the earliest preserved copy of the errata slip); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was the PC-E1 version of Tarkin Doctrine first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} The PC card image of 8 July 2018 (Holotable commit 022435b) prints the same text with the “E” mark. Text: “Deploy on Death Star system. During your control phase, for each battleground system controlled by your Star Destroyer within 2 parsecs of Death Star, opponent loses 1 Force. Canceled if opponent controls this system.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “system”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-tdoc-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/tarkindoctrine.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “Deploy on Death Star system. During your control phase, for each battleground system controlled by your Star Destroyer within 2 parsecs of Death Star, opponent loses 1 Force. Canceled if opponent controls this system.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.

|rulings=* Even if the [[Death Star]] is somehow a battleground (e.g. due to [[Presence Of The Force]]), it does not count as being a battleground system within 2 parsecs of itself.<ref>Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json official Dark card data], Tarkin Doctrine rulings.</ref>
* If there are (for example) 2 applicable systems, this card initiates a single instance of 2 Force loss (not '1 and 1').
* This mandatory action may be initiated by Dark as a top-level action. If both players pass consecutively during Dark's control phase and this hasn't been initiated yet, it initiates itself as an automatic action.
